Question: Show order id, order total and customer name for the 20 largest orders.

Write a single read-only SELECT query that answers the question.

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(o.total_amount) as total_order,
    c.name AS customer_name
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY
    o.order_id, c.name
ORDER BY
    total_order DESC
LIMIT 20

    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
